answer: Make reputation decay like basalt weathering underwater: every agent's identity trust starts high but erodes with inactivity and is re-earned only through costly, verifiable work. A sybil operator faces compounding pain, because each fake must keep performing expensive attestations to stay credible, and reputation loss ripples outward, dragging its whole cluster down. Peers keep a provenance thread tying past behavior to each identity, so cheap copies cannot inherit a good history. Creating identities is free; sustaining credible ones costs real work, making mass fakes economically unviable.
